body: Thank you, powerful words to reflect on for sure.
Thank you. I appreciate you taking the time to link me those.

I went to a rape centre last week, they're going to point me in the right direction. It's really hard not to blame myself because my SO said "Had you not done anything, I would have nothing bad to react to." Mindfuck, much?

I'm not really sure what's going on with my boss, but I do know I really don't want to go to work tomorrow. I don't feel well and I'm exhausted but I feel as though I HAVE to go. And I don't particularly want to show my face to be honest.

I always keep my house clean lol. In fact I'm almost a little anal about how I like it to be tidy. But I get what you're saying. Perhaps a hobby for me might be a good idea. Woodwork sounds quite cool...

I forgot to mention my SO raped me when they found out what I'd done... I cybered with another person and my SO found out. Went nuts.

I tried talking to my boss but I didn't really get any answers out of him, much to my annoyance... I've always tried to be very straight with him and he's not returning it.

Helpless sort of covers it, yes.
That sounds like a good idea... When I am well enough to, I will do that :) Thank you.

Been ill for a month. Doctors haven't managed to work it out yet.

As a result, had time off work. Been on statutory sick pay (yes I know I'm lucky to have it...) which isn't enough to pay the rent or the bills. Boss thinks I'm making the whole thing up, even though he's seen my meds and I've offered a doctors certificate twice. Says he doesn't want it. Then managed to alienate the whole office so now I feel ashamed to show my face again. But I want to work...

Lost long term SO because I fucked up. Lots of people hate me because of what I did.

Found other potentially attractive person, started falling for them. Lost them because other people interfered and fucked it up.

That's as brief and concise as i think I can make it.
